_comment: Operator identity manifest for Freedom Yield Metal Blockchain validator. Signed with the operator identity key whose public form is at /.well-known/operator-identity.pub. Verification uses ssh-keygen -Y verify (OpenSSH 8.0+). The validator's staker.key / BLS signer.key are NOT used in this signature. This example documents the schema; the live file is generated by scripts/operator-local/gen-identity.sh on the operator's local Mac.
